all**. Your completion report is the whole deliverable, and three nodes read it as their
input. Report these six sections, under these headings, in this order.

this run wrote, so take it first and report it exactly.

**`CORPUS CENSUS`** — one line per file, `<path> | <lines> | <owning slice>`:

- `scratch/session-followups-20260820.md` — owner `slice-session`
- every `scratch/followup-*.md` — owner `slice-followups`
- `scratch/ANALYSIS-followups.md` — owner `slice-followups`

there; if the number differs, say so plainly with the count and the file list, because every
later node's accounting is measured against this census rather than against the brief.

## Why
The manager accumulated these notes across many sessions while supervising real work, and
they have never been read as a set. The user asked for this in their own words: *"go
through them one by one and verify the root cause, group everything by the root cause,
present root cause evidence and suggested fix; make sure the follow-up is not already

for the same or related issues."* The user wants to decide what to fix, and a finding that
